reapack.name: Dubbing_Prompter.lua
reapack.desc: Dubbing Prompter: subtitles, roles and takes for dubbing

metadata.description: Workstation for dubbing sound directors: prompter with the current line, subtitle import (SRT/ASS/SSA/VTT/TXT or tracks embedded in MKV/MP4 via ffmpeg), roles, recorded marks, takes, regions and text items synced with the cursor. Works together with Dubbing_SubOverlay.lua.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: New button "Delete subtitles, regions and items": removes the prompter lines, the regions made from them and the text-item track (undo with Ctrl+Z).

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Phone page: removed duplicate A-/A+ under the video (top buttons now hold-to-repeat); dots no longer overlap the video controls.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Phone page: Back/Next buttons moved under the video (landscape), dots centred under the video; fixed a typo that broke connection error messages.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Phone page: the top-right Back/Next toggle button now really shows/hides the bottom buttons and stays in sync with the dot.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Fix: the phone page now loads the lines and the video after refresh (it stayed on "No lines / No video in the project").

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Phone page: text size can be made much smaller and much larger (hold A- / A+ to change it quickly).

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Phone page: clearer A- / A+ text size buttons; larger text on tablets and wide screens.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Phone page: the previous/next lines around the current one are removed.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: One "Prompter on phone / tablet" button: creates the page and starts the video server. Fixes the error in the video buttons; MobileServer files are installed.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Fix: "Prompter: video for phone" and "Prompter: video server" no longer fail; the video server files (MobileServer) are now installed.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Phone/tablet prompter page: Russian/English/Japanese/Chinese, previous and next lines around the current one, "my role" filter with a countdown to your next line, timecode with a progress bar, refreshed look.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Multilingual interface: Russian, English, Japanese, Chinese. The language follows the REAPER language pack automatically (including Chinese packs); change it in the "More" menu and restart the script.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Multilingual interface: Russian, English, Japanese, Chinese. Language follows the REAPER language pack automatically; change it in the "More" menu (restart the script after switching).

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Menus no longer click the button under them; the replica list scrolls to the current replica; file dialogs remember the last folder; F1-F5 switch screens directly (F5 = text with the top bar), F6 = help.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Single script folder: ffmpeg/ffprobe are found in Scripts/Dubbing System.

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
version.changelog: Installer and ReaPack now use the same folder (no duplicate scripts).

version.author: zaraki999kenpachi
